newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady at the lower levels, thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady at the lower levels, thin.

text.p: NWE spot and paper naphtha prices were holding steady at the lower levels in late trade on Friday, supported by firmer crude and as NYMEX gasoline futures gained ground, traders said.

Barges talked in a wider range around $174-$177. Cargo sellers eased offers a couple of dollars but a dearth of buying interest left the market notional around $173/$178 cif NWE with May paper at a similar level. "Sellers levels continue to drift lower but are still failing to attract fresh buying interest," one trader said. "I think people are waiting to see if gasoline prices picks-up."

Gasoline eased on Wednesday after bearish API U.S. stock data and demand forecasts, but the hefty inventory builds were offset by a change in sentiment and forecasts that gasoline will rally soon on seasonal driving demand.
Naphtha losses have outpaced those on gasoline with ample refinery supply in ARA and slack petrochemical demand taking the naphtha/gasoline spread out to around $15 a tonne.
